editorial:
Imagine being head over heels in love with your partner, but you just cannot agree on the biggest decision of your life: having a baby. That is exactly where you find Olivia and Alex. They are a sweet lesbian couple with a bit of an age gap, and while they adore each other, the pressure to start a family starts to tear them apart. Just when things get tense, their friendly neighbor John enters the picture. He seems like a great guy, but his presence turns their world upside down and leads them to make some truly wild and messy choices. It is a quirky ride that blends relationship drama with some really awkward comedy.

What you will love most is how the movie handles the tension between the three characters. The acting feels natural, and the way the plot twists makes it hard to look away. While some parts of the story feel a bit slow, the payoff is worth it. If you are in the mood for something light but thought-provoking, you should definitely check this out. For the best experience, try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video to catch all the detail, or you can rent it on Apple TV for a cozy movie night at home.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the secrets about John and the pregnancy plans finally explode. After a series of bad choices and emotional fights, the couple has to face the reality of their relationship. They realize that bringing a child into their chaotic situation was a mistake. In the end, they decide to focus on fixing their own bond first, letting go of the drama with John to find a healthier way to move forward together.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves relationship comedies and stories about modern families.
